meta.title: Lonoke County — the money trail
meta.note: This is Lonoke County's 2026 operating budget, dated November 20, 2025, which the quorum court adopted by ordinance and filed with the state. Amounts come from each office's 2026 appropriation page. The Jail Maintenance fund ($150,000) and Jail Employment fund ($237,000) send money to the Law Enforcement fund, so those dollars are counted in both places.

nodes.name: County General Fund
nodes.note: No fund total is printed; this is the sum of its departments.

nodes.name: Circuit Court Jury Fees
nodes.note: Only a total appropriation is printed (one jurors and witnesses line), so there are no category totals.

nodes.name: ARPA Revenue Replacement Fund
nodes.note: The book has two pages for this fund. Page 24 shows $8,085,900.52, which matches its list of projects (General Heat & Air $200,000.00; Justice Center $7,725,707.50; CAPDD $160,193.02). Page 25 shows $8,655,489.31 with the note 'This amount is different b/c of spending before budget was approved.' We use page 24 and do not count both.

nodes.name: Lonoke Co. Veterans Memorial Grant Fund
Circuit Clerk Child Support
nodes.note: The page also prints 'TOTAL CAPITAL OUTLAYS $2,150.00', but it lists no capital items and the total appropriation is $2,150.00, so that line repeats the other-services total; it is left out.

nodes.name: Collector's Automation Fund
nodes.note: Only page 2 of this form is in the filed document (p. 106). It prints the other-services total ($139,000.00) and the total appropriation ($357,228.13); page 1 with personal services and supplies is missing, so the categories shown do not add up to the total.

nodes.name: Law Enforcement Fund
nodes.note: No fund total is printed; this is the sum of its departments.

nodes.name: Sheriff Fan Fund
nodes.note: Only an unlabeled $95.00 subtotal and the total appropriation are printed, so there are no category totals.

nodes.name: Sheriff's Grant Fund
nodes.note: The 'TOTAL APPROPRIATION' line on this page is blank; this is its printed other-services total.
